coverageNotes: Built from personal Gmail (fabianferno@gmail.com) only; mail not mutated. Searched eticket/airline/OTA/PNR queries with pagination until exhausted for primary queries. Air India web etickets (8JRFSC, U3AKBI) are PDF-only in body—segment times for AI538/AI2454 come from calendar/boarding notifications. Some connecting times for Kiwi 694194248 (UX1094 dep, EY102 dep, EY342 dep) inferred from duration+arrival. Cleartrip H25810 airline PNR not clearly present in plaintext. AI148/AI2525 PNR unknown from operational emails. London SIU4ZY marked cancelled per MMT cancelled-invoice. IndiGo E9FBRD outbound cancelled; return treated cancelled. SriLankan Cleartrip 9XWFZG fully cancelled/refunded. Ignored Maharaja Club marketing, FlixBus, NueGo bus, rail e-tickets, fake ABC12345 test emails, Leo Franklin John companion ticket as separate passenger. Work Gmail not systematically searched—personal coverage looked complete for major trips; may miss employer-only bookings. PDF attachment contents not OCR'd; filenames noted in notes.
